verdicts.why: At the end of The Devil Complex Coulson agrees to go with Hale; Ruby does not capture him. In Rise and Shine she tries to unsettle him and fails.
Price dies in Closure (S3E9); Coulson kills Ward on Maveth in S3E10, so 'avenges her' spoils a later episode, while hunting her killer fits S3E9.
In The Hub (S1E7) Hand sends Ward and Fitz in with no extraction plan, Coulson confronts her and rescues them with May.
The extraction clash is S1E7 (new stage); the Hydra suspicion and the alliance to retake the Hub are S1E16-17.
In Resurrection (S3E1) Hattley refuses to move up Nadeem's review and sends him to Fisk at Rikers; her service to Fisk is only revealed in Revelations (S3E9).

value.title: Daredevil S3#9
value.text: Hattley, who put Nadeem in charge of Fisk's transfer, turns out to be working for Fisk. She kills Agent Winn with Nadeem's gun to frame him, then pressures him to keep obeying Fisk.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Nadeem's FBI boss, who frames him for Winn's murder to keep him serving Fisk.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An agent Hattley frames for murder and forces to obey Fisk.

verdicts.why: The S3E9 betrayal is right, but the fact cut from the moved stage (she puts Nadeem in charge of Fisk's transfer, S3E2) was dropped, so it is carried here.
In One Last Shot Vanessa urges that Nadeem be eliminated and later says she ordered his assassination; Poindexter shoots him. No source shows them meeting.
Sonya gives 'Rhodes' the New Skrullos intel (ep 5), then traps Raava with Fury and holds her at gunpoint; Raava grabs her gun and Fury kills her (ep 6). No order to kill Sonya is shown.
Drax, with the other Guardians, frees Phyla and the Star Children; she later joins Rocket's new Guardians on Krylor.
Phastos hesitates when Sersi and Ikaris ask; his husband Ben convinces him.
At Ta Lo Razor Fist joins the villagers against the Soul Eaters and then serves Xialing, so the film leaves him on Shang-Chi's side.
Ronan kills the Other, defies Thanos and keeps the Power Stone for himself, so the film leaves them enemies.
Ridley is made deputy chief in S2E1 and is called Deputy Chief when she returns in S2E9, before the S2E12 immunity deal.

value.text: Ruth Bat-Seraph serves as President Ross's national security adviser and is one of his most trusted aides, kept in on secrets like Samuel Sterns's imprisonment. She believes Ross has become a better man, but when she teams up with Sam Wilson to stop Sterns, Ross cuts her off and tells her she failed.

verdicts.why: She does work with Sam against Ross's wishes and Ross scolds her on the USS Milius, but he only cuts her off and says she failed; 'turns on her' overstates it.
Sam's sister calls 'Smiling Tiger' Sam, blowing Sam's cover; Selby orders all three killed and is shot by Sharon.
Sam and Wanda are both in the new Avengers lineup at the end of Age of Ultron, so this stage begins there.
Goes with the added Age of Ultron stage; Lagos and siding with Steve are Civil War events.
In Soliloquy of Chaos (S1E12) Zip tries to strangle Shades on Diamondback's orders and Shades kills him, so the episode leaves them enemies.
Rivera is already Fisk's campaign manager in Heaven's Half Hour (episode 1); she becomes chief of staff in Optics.
Kathy Friedman (episode 7): Trevor confesses his Damage Control deal to spy on Simon, and Simon destroys a set with an explosion.
Yucca Valley (episode 8): Trevor takes the blame as the Mandarin and is jailed, and Simon breaks him out of the Damage Control prison.
By the end of Civil War T'Challa knows Zemo is the killer and shelters Steve and Bucky in Wakanda, so they end as allies.
Sylvie tries to kill Victor and spares him in '1893' (S2E3), and Loki and Mobius take him to the TVA in that episode.
After the fight she shows Tafari the doomed future, and he insists on putting the axe back, which he does.
W'Kabi backs Killmonger and leads the Border Tribe against T'Challa, standing down only when Okoye confronts him.
Thanos grabs T'Challa by the shoulder with the Gauntlet hand and punches him out; no throat grab or slam.
In the Doctor Strange mid-credits scene Strange agrees to help Thor find Odin if they leave; Loki dropping through a portal is the Thor: Ragnarok version.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#9
value.text: Tucker Shockley is the right-hand man of the Superior, leader of the Watchdogs. When Senator Nadeer hesitates to kill her Inhuman brother, the Superior orders Shockley to finish the job.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The Superior's loyal right-hand man in the Watchdogs.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Shockley's leader in the Watchdogs, whom Shockley serves loyally.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#13
split.text: Shockley becomes an Inhuman himself, and Ivanov rejects him in disgust. Shockley still begs to serve and stays loyal to the Watchdogs.
split.on_a_card_about_b: His right-hand man, who stays loyal after becoming an Inhuman.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The Watchdogs leader who rejects Shockley for being Inhuman, though Shockley stays loyal.

verdicts.why: In Broken Promises (S4E9) the Superior orders Shockley to kill Vijay, so the stage starts there, but Shockley only becomes Inhuman in BOOM (S4E13), so that part is split off.
Tommy and Billy are born in Now in Color (episode 3).
Paladin takes Tommy to Saint Mabyn's as bait and White Vision rescues him; nothing shows Vision hunting Tommy.
Wanda turns on Ultron in Seoul after reading his plan; Pietro dies later in Sokovia, so she does not turn on him after Pietro's death.
By the end of Age of Ultron Wanda has fought beside Tony and the Avengers in Sokovia and joined the new Avengers.
The deal ends with Ultron cutting off Klaue's arm in a rage, and they never work together again.
By the end of Thor: Ragnarok Valkyrie has helped start the revolt and fights her way off Sakaar against the Grandmaster's forces.
Simpson attacks Trish in S1E3, apologizes and bonds with her in S1E4, and they begin their romance in S1E5; the break-up is later.
In AKA 1,000 Cuts (S1E10) Trish sees how unstable Simpson is, sends him away and takes some of his pills.
In Into the Ring (S1E1) Turk runs the Russians' trafficking shipment and reports to Vladimir and Anatoly; the betrayal is S1E5.
In World on Fire (S1E5) Wesley pays Turk to tell Vladimir that Fisk killed Anatoly, which sends Vladimir's men into the bombings.

value.title: Daredevil S1#4
value.text: Wilson Fisk is drawn to art dealer Vanessa Marianna and takes her to dinner, but a mob interruption leaves her unsure how she feels about him.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A man who courts Vanessa and takes her to dinner.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The art dealer Fisk falls for and takes to dinner.

split.title: Daredevil S1#5
split.text: Wilson Fisk falls in love with art dealer Vanessa Marianna, and she stands by him even after learning what he is.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The man Vanessa loves. She stands by him after learning what he is.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The art dealer Fisk loves. Stands by him.

verdicts.why: S1E3 only has them meeting over a painting; he asks her to dinner in S1E4, and she accepts what he does in S1E5, so the stage starts at S1E4 and the rest is split to S1E5.

value.title: Daredevil S1#5
value.text: Vladimir Ranskahov partners with Fisk until Fisk murders his brother Anatoly. Vladimir then declares war on Fisk.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Vladimir's former partner. Murders Vladimir's brother Anatoly.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A former partner who turns on Fisk after Anatoly's murder.

split.title: Daredevil S1#6
split.text: Trapped by the police, Vladimir knows Fisk's men on the force will silence him. He stays behind and dies fighting.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Vladimir's former partner, whose men on the force hunt him down.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A former partner who dies fighting rather than be silenced.

verdicts.why: Vladimir learns of Anatoly's murder and goes to war in S1E5, but he dies in S1E6, so the death is split off.
In Life of the Party (S2E6) Whitney destroys Chadwick and half the Council and takes over, and Masters captures Underwood for her; the betrayal is S2E9.

value.title: Agent Carter S2#9
value.text: Masters joins Jack Thompson, Peggy Carter and Daniel Sousa in a plan to turn the gamma cannon on Whitney. Thompson hands him over to her, and she begins to absorb him.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The Council's leader, whom Masters plots to kill. She begins to absorb him.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A Council man who plots against Whitney, and whom she begins to absorb.

verdicts.why: In S2E9 Thompson turns Masters over and Frost begins killing him, but Wilkes's explosion interrupts and the wiki lists Masters's fate as unknown, so 'she kills him' is not supported; the deal with Carter and Sousa cut from the moved stage is kept.
Alistair and Doctor Octopus join the Red Skull in The Gauntlet of the Red Skull (#62), where the Skull is beaten and Alistair helps the heroes; #63 starts after the Skull's defeat.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#2
value.text: Spencer Smythe is Alistair's father, who builds the Spider-Slayer partly to get his paralyzed son a hoverchair. When the plan fails, he seems to die in an explosion.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Alistair's father, who seems to die in an explosion.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Spencer's son, for whose hoverchair he builds the Spider-Slayer.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#35
split.text: Alistair learns the Kingpin has kept his father frozen all along, takes back his body and works to revive him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Alistair's father, whom he works to bring back.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Spencer's son, who fights to revive him.

verdicts.why: The family stage starts at #2, but the frozen-body discovery is in The Ultimate Slayer (#35), so that part is split off instead of dropped. Norman, not Spencer, builds the hoverchair, so that card line is fixed.
Kingpin forms the Insidious Six, with Doctor Octopus and the Chameleon, in Chapter I: The Insidious Six (#14), and they take on Spider-Man there.
